records.title: GNΩSIS: Lessons Learned in Generating a High-Level Synthesis Dataset
records.reason: A generic HLS dataset/framework is linked to FPGA-based LLM inference, so the data/design-space method might enable inference-specific DSE; the available abstract describes broad benchmark suites but does not establish LLM workloads. Primary ACM full text could not be retrieved for this screening.

records.title: Fast Model Selection and Stable Optimization for Softmax-Gated Multinomial-Logistic Mixture of Experts Models
records.reason: The primary abstract identifies batch statistical MoE model estimation/model selection for biological protein-interaction prediction; it does not describe neural LLM expert routing, LLM inference, or a serving-efficiency method. The broad survey lineage alone is not a technical connection.

records.title: Late-to-Early Training: LET LLMs Learn Earlier, So Faster and Better
records.reason: The contribution accelerates LLM pretraining by transferring late-stage representations into earlier training/layers; its measured gains concern training time and training quality, not inference cost or deployment.

records.title: Orthogonal Self-Attention
records.reason: Orthogonal attention proposes linear sequence-length computational/memory scaling, but the full text is about non-causal, skipless Transformer training and does not establish autoregressive LLM inference applicability.

records.title: Partial Ring Scan: Revisiting Scan Order in Vision State Space Models
records.reason: The primary method and evaluations address 2D vision SSM scan orders for image tasks; no language-model or LLM inference result is established.
